wbs.description: Document the current closed-chain architecture: state-factory, guard-registry, state-bootstrap walk, and the installed-guard-path interlock.
Survey stage-name coupling across lib modules and classify literals as role, edge-scope-deletable, or false positive.
Resolve the migration story against existing precedents and produce the external-gate threat model with its controls.
Produce the proceed/defer/reshape recommendation with the follow-on epic outline and record divergences from the spike body.

testImpact.isolation: discovery spike; no code changes, no test lanes exercised

risks: Role-extraction sweep is wide (~50 sites) and risks corrupting false-positive stage literals if mechanized.
GitHub Projects option-id stability across label rename is unverified and reshapes the compiler design.
The gate-development escape hatch is the weak point of the external-gate security model.
